name: TJ's Grill (Montpelier, ID) Charbroiled Flat Iron Steak & Baked Idaho Potato
whyItWorks: Flat iron steak is naturally uniform, tender, and lean with no tough connective gristle. Charbroiled with sea salt and paired with fluffy baked Idaho potato flesh.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Flat Iron Steak cooked medium with a baked potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip potato skin).
